title: Distinct by Length
prompt:
**Problem.** Line 1: string s. Line 2: q. Each next line: L.
Print, per query, the number of distinct substrings of s with length
exactly L.

**Constraints:** 1 ≤ |s| ≤ 1000; 1 ≤ q ≤ 100; 1 ≤ L ≤ |s|.

Rolling hash + sort/unique per length.

tests.name: tiny
single char repeats
tests.hint: Every window is the same char run: 1 distinct per length.

tests.name: load: 1000-char string, 5 lengths
tests.hint: Rolling hash per length; the naive set-of-substrings approach is O(n^2) memory/time and dies on L=500.
